description: Data center projects in Texas (hyperscale, AI campuses, colocation, HPC conversions, powered land) near an address or coordinate, in a county, by status, or by company: name, companies (developer, end user, parents), status and date, MW, acres, capex, utility and substation, tax abatements, local opposition, confidence and sources. Barrio Energy research compiled from utility and PUCT filings, county and city records, abatement agreements and news. Use for 'what data centers are near X', 'data centers in Y County', 'who is building data centers in Texas', 'where is Google building'. Free accounts get locations only; names, companies, status, MW and sources are Pro. Status and company filtering are Pro. Campuses list their buildings; MW totals count campuses only.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

company.description: Company name, e.g. Google, Crusoe, CyrusOne (Pro).

county.description: Texas county name. Use this or a location.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

radius_mi.description: Radius around the location in miles. Default 25, max 150.

status.description: Filter by status group. Cancelled projects are left out unless asked for.

name: data_centers
title: Texas data center projects
